optimum_source: planted, then verified: every variable in the weighted sum carries a positive weight and is bounded below but not above, so each is driven to its floor. t has no constraint and only its non-negativity, giving t*=0; v is bounded below only by v_i >= z_i with z binary and unconstrained, so z*=0 forces v*=0. The remaining objective is the constant term sum_i e_i = 4+7+2 = 13, which is therefore the optimum for any positive w_late and w_energy.
